# Statement of Purpose

## Motivation
I am Rahul Sharma, a B.Tech graduate in Computer Science and Engineering with a strong passion for Artificial Intelligence, Machine Learning, Computer Vision, and Natural Language Processing. My experiences building AI solutions—such as a crop‑disease detector and an educational chatbot—have convinced me that advanced research in Canada will enable me to create technologies that address real‑world challenges.

## Academic Background
I completed my B.Tech in Computer Science and Engineering at Lovely Professional University, achieving a CGPA of 8.5/10 (85.0%). My coursework and projects gave me solid foundations in Python, PyTorch, scikit‑learn, Pandas, NumPy, FastAPI, Docker, Git, SQL, and LangChain.

## Relevant Projects
- **Crop Disease Detector** – Developed a CNN classifier that identifies leaf diseases with 94% accuracy on a PlantVillage subset. (GitHub: `github.com/rahul-sharma-ai/crop-disease-detector`)
- **RAG College Assistant** – Built a retrieval‑augmented QA chatbot over university handbook PDFs using LlamaIndex and Groq, enabling students to obtain precise information quickly. (GitHub: `github.com/rahul-sharma-ai/rag-college-assistant`)
- **Loan Default Prediction** – Implemented a gradient‑boosting model achieving 0.87 AUC and performed a feature‑importance study to aid financial risk assessment. (Resume)

## Why This Program
The Department of Computer Science’s funding package aligns perfectly with my goals. The guaranteed funding for a 16‑month MSc, an enhanced living allowance of $39,500 after tuition, and a departmental fellowship up to $17,250 CAD provide a secure environment for focused research. The application deadline of December 1, 2026 gives me ample time to prepare a strong submission. Moreover, internal awards are nominated by the admissions committee, allowing me to concentrate on my research proposal rather than separate award applications.

## Future Goals
I aim to pursue graduate research that advances AI applications in agriculture and education, publishing in top conferences and collaborating with industry partners. After completing my master’s, I plan to continue to a Ph.D. and eventually lead interdisciplinary AI projects that improve food security and learning outcomes worldwide.
